tools.description: Nmap's network Swiss Army knife for connectivity and data transfer
tools.usage:
ncat -l 8080 # Listen on port 8080
ncat example.com 80 # Connect to HTTP port
ncat --broker --listen 8080 # Chat server
ncat --ssl example.com 443 # SSL connection
echo 'GET / HTTP/1.0' | ncat example.com 80

tools.description: Network reconnaissance engine with NSE scripts for deep service enumeration and OS fingerprinting
tools.usage:
nmap -sS -O target.com # Stealth SYN scan with OS detection
nmap --script vuln target.com # Vulnerability enumeration
nmap -sV --script discovery target.com # Service version detection
nmap -p- --min-rate 10000 target.com # Fast full port scan
